text:
Here is the result of "fetch" for the Page with URL https://app.notion.com/p/3b2792ca0888818c8b64eeecc699223e as of 2026-08-04T21:48:38.227Z: {"title":"Foundry Roadmap"} {"type":"emoji","emoji":"🗺️"} **Owner**: Product Owner (Tait) with support from Interim Governance (Morgan Lee) **Status**: Living document – first version 2026-08-04 **Purpose**: Sequence the remaining work to finish and lock the Foundry skills layer (00–04) so it is fully repeatable and ready to lift into larger projects (e.g. MindLever X). --- ## Phase 0 – Foundation (Complete / Near-complete) - [x] Governance Charter v0.2+ - [x] Governance Playbook v0.2+ - [x] Team Charter - [x] Decision Log (proper schema) - [x] GitHub repo `Foundry-Skills` created and seeded - [ ] Final review & lock of locked rules (Appetite, Future Customer Experience, Kill Criteria, UI/A11y) **Target**: Done by end of this week --- ## Phase 1 – Core Skills Completeness (Next 1–2 weeks) **Goal**: Make every skill (00–04) production-ready, documented, and testable.
Item Owner Status Notes
00-foundry (Orchestrator) final polish Governance + Engineering Not started Must enforce order + missing-artifact brakes
01-foundry-whitespace Governance + UX Not started Appetite lock + Target Shape fit
02-foundry-concept Governance + Validation Not started Explicit GO/PIVOT/PROBE/KILL + Future Customer Experience
03-foundry-brief Governance + UX Not started Full Craft Brief with UI/A11y constraints
04-foundry-craft Engineering + Quality Not started Functional prototype under ≤60s / one primary path
Skill test harness / example cycle Engineering Not started One end-to-end dry-run
**Exit criteria**: One complete, documented cycle that a new team member can run without tribal knowledge. --- ## Phase 2 – Supporting Infrastructure (Parallel / overlapping) - [ ] Requirements database (or linked view) - [ ] Architecture page (skills architecture + hand-off points to Claude / GitHub) - [ ] Backlog database - [ ] Decision Log protocol fully operational (already schema-ready) - [ ] Versioned markdown mirrors of all governance docs in GitHub **Owner**: Governance + Engineering --- ## Phase 3 – Team Readiness & Handoff - [ ] Clear RACI for virtual roles (Alex Rivera – Engineering, Sam Patel – UX, Casey Nguyen – Quality/Safety, Jordan Hale – Validation) - [ ] Ahmed consulted on technical architecture as needed - [ ] Short onboarding guide for any new team member - [ ] First real Whitespace cycle scheduled and run **Exit criteria**: Foundry is ready to be dropped into MindLever X (or any future project) with zero re-invention of process. --- ## Phase 4 – Scale & Integration (Future) - Integrate with Claude Code / Claude Design hand-off patterns - Connect to larger MindLever X workstreams - Continuous improvement of skills based on real cycle learnings --- ## How we track this - All material decisions logged in the Decision Log - Progress reviewed weekly by Product Owner + Interim Governance - Roadmap itself is updated in place (one home per fact) **Next immediate action**: Confirm Phase 0 lock items and start Phase 1 skill polish.
